reviewer_name_or_role: Crew Blueprint evidence-matrix structural audit (AI-assisted; not qualified Video/LED practitioner approval)
equipment_jurisdiction_context: Current Video C1 includes physical LED cabinet handling/locking support language while the course is not tied to one exact manufacturer/model/manual
findings: Do not strengthen or release a repeatable physical locking/assembly practical as transferable across LED products. Exact manufacturer/model documentation and qualified adult workplace/Video-LED practitioner review are required for the actual equipment used.

reviewer_name_or_role: Crew Blueprint evidence-matrix structural audit (AI-assisted; not structural, rigging, electrical, venue or AHJ approval)
equipment_jurisdiction_context: Video C2 structural-support lesson and cross-domain authority boundary
findings: The learner-facing authority separation is appropriate. Keep structural/rigging/power/wind acceptance outside Video authority and avoid converting awareness language into load calculation, attachment, hoisting, ballast, wind-threshold or structural acceptance instruction.

equipment_jurisdiction_context: Current Video C2 includes the sentence 'Dynamic load can exceed static weight' in the structural-awareness lesson
findings: Retain the general warning only after it is tied to an exact controlling structural/rigging source and reviewed by a qualified structural/rigging practitioner for the intended context. Do not infer a universal calculation or operational threshold from generic structural language.

equipment_jurisdiction_context: Video C2 IP-rating lesson and existing scored question
findings: The core distinction is source-supported: IEC 60529 defines ingress-protection classification, not complete outdoor-event suitability. Positive claims about actual weather, wind, structural or lightning suitability still require their own product/site/authority evidence.
